school: 中国改革开放总设计师/务实主义政治家
historical_significance: 邓小平（1904—1997），原名邓先圣，学名希贤，四川广安人，中国改革开放的总设计师。十六岁赴法勤工俭学，在法国加入旅欧中国共产主义青年团，此后历经百色起义、太行抗日、千里跃进大别山、淮海与渡江战役，是军政兼备的实干家。文革中三落三起：1933年因拥护毛泽东正确路线被批斗撤职（第一落），1966年文革被打倒下放江西新建县拖拉机厂劳动（第二落），1976年再次被撤销一切职务（第三落），每次都凭务实品格与党内人望重新复出。1978年中共十一届三中全会前后，他支持真理标准大讨论，提出'解放思想，实事求是，团结一致向前看'，确立以经济建设为中心的基本路线。其改革方法论极具个人印记：'不管黑猫白猫，捉到老鼠就是好猫'的实用判据、'摸着石头过河'的渐进试错、'不争论'的行动优先、'让一部分人先富起来'的非均衡激励、经济特区'试验田—推广'的试点扩散机制。他主持平反冤假错案、恢复高考、推动家庭联产承包、设立深圳等四个经济特区，1992年南方谈话以'发展才是硬道理'重启改革。在统一问题上提出'一国两制'构想，促成香港澳门回归安排；在外交上确立'韬光养晦、有所作为'方针；在制度上废除领导职务终身制、推动干部退休制度化并设立顾问委员会，和平实现权力交接。1997年2月19日逝世，遵遗愿捐献角膜、骨灰撒入大海。
historical_significance_en: Deng Xiaoping (1904-1997), originally named Deng Xiansheng, school name Xixian, born in Guang'an, Sichuan, was the chief architect of China's Reform and Opening. He left for work-study in France at sixteen, joined the Communist Youth League there, and went on through the Baise Uprising, the Taihang resistance, the leap into the Dabie Mountains, and the Huaihai and Yangtze campaigns—a soldier-administrator of rare practicality. He fell from power three times and rose three times: purged in 1933 for backing Mao Zedong's correct line, toppled in the Cultural Revolution of 1966 and sent to labor in a tractor factory in Xinjian County, Jiangxi, and stripped of all posts again in 1976—each time returning on his pragmatic record and standing within the Party. Around the Third Plenum of the Eleventh Central Committee in 1978 he backed the truth-criterion debate and called on the country to 'emancipate the mind, seek truth from facts, and unite as one in looking to the future,' establishing economic construction as the Party's central task. His reform methodology bore his personal stamp: the pragmatic test 'it doesn't matter whether a cat is black or white, so long as it catches mice'; 'crossing the river by feeling the stones'; 'no debating'—action before words; 'let some people get rich first'; and the Special Economic Zone as a pilot field for experiment-and-diffusion. He rehabilitated the wrongly persecuted, restored the college entrance examination, extended the household contract system, and founded the Shenzhen SEZ; his 1992 Southern Tour rebooted reform with 'development is the hard truth.' He devised 'One Country, Two Systems' for Hong Kong and Macao, set the foreign-policy line of 'biding time while building capability,' abolished life tenure for leading cadres, and institutionalized retirement and orderly succession. He died on 19 February 1997, donating his corneas and giving his ashes to the sea.

cross_references.relation_type: 实事求是传承：从《实践论》到真理标准讨论
cross_references.description_zh: 毛泽东以《实践论》确立'实事求是'为党的思想路线，又在晚年以政治运动压倒了这一路线；邓小平以'完整准确地理解毛泽东思想'为旗号，把实事求是从教条束缚中解放出来，用同一面旗帜纠正了挥旗者自己的偏差。二人共同说明：任何思想路线都可能被其创立者后期的实践所背离，回到'实事求是'即回到'以实践而非文本为检验标准'。
cross_references.description_en: Mao Zedong established 'seeking truth from facts' as the Party's ideological line in On Practice, then in his later years overwhelmed that line with political campaigns; Deng Xiaoping, under the banner of 'understanding Mao Zedong Thought accurately and as a whole,' liberated the principle from dogma and used the same flag to correct the deviations of the very person who raised it. Together they show that any ideological line can be betrayed by its founder's later practice, and that returning to 'seeking truth from facts' means returning to practice—not text—as the criterion of truth.

cross_references.relation_type: 渐进务实：结硬寨与摸石头
cross_references.description_zh: 曾国藩以'结硬寨、打呆仗'不求奇胜、日拱一卒地压缩不确定性；邓小平以'摸着石头过河'拒绝休克疗法、以试点—评估—推广的小步快走推进变革。二人相隔百年，共享同一种在巨大风险面前放弃总蓝图、靠可逆的小步试错积累确定性的战略气质。
cross_references.description_en: Zeng Guofan sought no brilliant stroke with 'strong stockades and dull battles,' compressing uncertainty one plodding day at a time; Deng Xiaoping refused shock therapy with 'crossing the river by feeling the stones,' advancing reform through small, reversible, evaluated-and-diffused steps. A century apart, they share one strategic temperament: before enormous risk, abandon the master blueprint and accumulate certainty through reversible small-step trial and error.
